attempts.summary: Set an apt hold on the curl package (7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19) on node1 using `apt-mark hold curl`, confirmed via a simulated `apt-get upgrade -s` that curl is excluded from update candidates even though other packages would be upgraded, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id/curl state, rebooted node1 with `systemctl reboot`, polled until it came back with a new boot_id, and reverified curl's package/hold state and version were unchanged post-restart.
